result.summary: The application interface is mostly functional, but there is a clear layout issue at the bottom of the screen where an image/card is cut off.

issues.description: The item card at the bottom of the screen (showing a pizza with a -20% tag) is partially cropped, preventing the user from seeing the full name or details of the restaurant.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or scroll container to ensure the last item in the list is fully visible before the bottom navigation bar.
